snippet.title: Battle of Hoth for the Apple II
snippet.description:
You control a snowspeeder and you have to destroy AT-AT's before they can reach turrets and destroy them...or before one of those AT-AT's can reach a turret.

Okay game, but for some reason the snowspeeder is bigger and thicker than the AT-AT's, which I don't understand. And I just saw the movie (again) one week ago on TV. 

Anyways, this destroys the rating...going from a good rating to a "just" mediocre one...
